speaker: josias_thwaite
text: For the Queen's majesty. And for her ships in this late trouble.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Forty sail, set against the galleys in the west. That is the number I was given.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: For Cornwall, where they have been ashore. For Devon, which came up the road in the same breath. County by county.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have the west, Master Thwaite. You have not the names of the towns.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The towns will keep till a better report. Forty is the number I was given, and I have prayed it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pray the counties, Master Thwaite. I will not add a town in the middle of a prayer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard it yesterday as talk. I am not going to mend a prayer with talk.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are done with the west. We can go home to dinner.
